name: conversational-causality-boundaries-v1
label_source: Initial assistant review of primary abstracts/publisher text, not an independently adjudicated gold standard.

cases.label_rationale: Intervenes on an agent step, replays subsequent execution and estimates outcome effects.
Ablates untrusted input spans and measures their influence on privileged actions.
Models dependencies within agent trajectories and asks whether blocking an injection changes harm.
Perturbs inter-agent messages and compares downstream action distributions.
Uses step-level interventions on execution traces to attribute and repair failures.

cases.challenge: positive without causal or agent in title
cases.label_rationale: Context attribution by input removal supports interpretation and poisoning detection; distinguish single-response context attribution from multi-step replay.
Interventions target hidden activations and feed-forward weights rather than conversational traces.
Tests a model answering causal questions, rather than causal analysis of the model agent conversation.
Role-playing simulacra do not provide a causal method for conversational behavior.
